cases.disposition_reason: Revert restores the applied Admin role and Dana stays unselected
cases.action_sequence: Exercise none, single, and multiple selection, range, toggle, and Select All with a disabled row. Move the cursor without replacing the set. Apply and revert a mixed bulk field.
cases.expected_results: The selected identities match the policy. Cursor movement keeps the set. Select All skips disabled rows.

80x24.precondition: narrow playground before the terminal grows

single.precondition: Space selects Ari and leaves Dana clear

range.precondition: Shift+Down extends the set to Cleo and the bulk role stays mixed

move.precondition: Down moves the cursor to Bo and keeps Ari and Cleo selected

toggle.precondition: Space on Cleo removes her and leaves Ari selected

all.precondition: Select All checks every enabled row and skips Dana

dirty.precondition: the mixed role is Admin, with Apply, Revert, and Unsaved changes

applied.precondition: Apply writes Admin for the 11 selected members

after.precondition: Revert restores the applied Admin role and Dana stays unselected
